description: SEC filings of a US public company from EDGAR by ticker or CIK: the latest 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, Form 4 and other forms with dates and document links, optionally one form type. Use to find a company's annual or quarterly report, insider trades or recent events. Example: ticker=AAPL. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193 (instead of ticker)

form.description: Only this form type, e.g. 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K or 4 (default: all)

ticker.description: Stock ticker such as AAPL (or give cik)

name: sec_edgar
title: SEC filings: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K by ticker
